english.note: Use this when the disgusting thing is nauseating or makes you feel physically sick.
Use this for the physical feeling of nausea or wanting to vomit.
Use this when someone feels nauseated or has an urge to vomit rather than simply being sick.

examples.english: That stinky tofu is really disgusting.
examples.jyutping: go2 di1 cau3 dau6 fu6 zan1 hai6 faan2 wai6

examples.english: I feel sick as soon as I smell that.
examples.jyutping: jat1 man4 dou2 zan6 mei6 ngo5 zau6 faan2 wai6

examples.english: After eating this dish, I feel ill and nauseated.
examples.traditional: 食完呢碟嘢，我有啲反胃。
examples.jyutping: sik6 jyun4 ni1 dip6 je5 ngo5 jau5 di1 faan2 wai6
